concept: A D docking frame and verification check; live text supplies the wordmark.
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create the finished original symbol for EvalDock, a professional software workbench for evaluating AI outputs and comparing experiments. Asset: a single square app icon / brand mark with a genuine transparent alpha background, not a mockup or a contact sheet. Design one bold geometric capital D as an open docking frame, integrated with a clean verification check in its counter/negative space. A coherent, recognizable silhouette, balanced flat vector-like geometry, substantial strokes and very few parts; clearly legible at 24 to 40 pixels. Use only solid cobalt blue #215ACB for the D frame and slate navy #172945 if one contrasting element is needed; prefer white/transparent negative space for the check. No gradients, shadows, bevels, thin outlines, glow, textures, decorative details or 3D. Center the emblem, occupying about 88% of the square canvas, with equal small transparent margins. Do not include the word EvalDock, any lettering other than the abstract D silhouette, any tagline, labels, swatches, borders, or presentation background. The result must be a ready-to-use transparent PNG brand asset, crisp and minimal, appropriate for a white sidebar and a GitHub README.
